files.content: "use client"; import { ChartLineUpIcon, DownloadSimpleIcon, MagnifyingGlassIcon, PackageIcon, PlusIcon, ReceiptIcon, TagIcon, UsersIcon, } from "@phosphor-icons/react"; import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react"; import { Button } from "../../vip-ui/button"; import { CommandPalette, CommandPaletteItem, CommandPaletteSection, } from "../../vip-ui/command-palette"; import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from "../../vip-ui/kbd-code"; const subscribe = () => () => {}; export function SearchCommand({ onExport }: { onExport: () => void }) { const [isOpen, setOpen] = useState(false); const isMac = useSyncExternalStore( subscribe, () => /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform), () => false, ); return ( <> Orders Customers Products Reports Add a product Make a discount code Export orders ); }
